plans.name: Audit
plans.summary: One-time written report. Separate from the free 15-minute call.
plans.billing: Charged once. Fully credited to setup if you start a paid plan within 14 days. No monthly fee.

plans.name: Starter
plans.summary: One agreed workflow, such as an enquiry assistant or bookings with reminders. 500 AI conversations a month.
plans.billing: Monthly price is billed in advance each month. Setup is a separate one-time charge. Yearly is billed in advance for the year and the setup fee is waived.

plans.name: Growth
plans.summary: Up to 3 agreed workflows. 1,500 AI conversations a month.
plans.billing: Monthly price is billed in advance each month. Setup is a separate one-time charge. Yearly is billed in advance for the year and the setup fee is waived.

plans.name: Managed Ops
plans.summary: Published plan for up to 6 agreed workflows and 4,000 AI conversations a month, including one or two no-API apps only after each is validated. The workflow list is written with you. The price is not a blank custom quote.
plans.billing: ₹19,999 is the monthly charge, billed in advance. ₹24,999 is a separate one-time setup. Yearly is ₹1,99,990 billed in advance and the setup fee is waived. Scope is agreed before any payment.

plans.name: Pilot Starter
plans.summary: Published pilot price for Starter for the first 3 months. Setup waived. The Audit fee is waived on this pilot. A person confirms a spot before any payment.
plans.billing: ₹2,499 is billed monthly in advance for the first 3 months only. Setup is ₹0. Cancel anytime during the pilot: the service stops at the end of the month already paid, and you are not billed again. This page does not bill a fourth month and does not set a separate renewal price.

plans.name: Pilot Growth
plans.summary: Published pilot price for Growth for the first 3 months. Setup waived. The Audit fee is waived on this pilot. A person confirms a spot before any payment.
plans.billing: ₹4,999 is billed monthly in advance for the first 3 months only. Setup is ₹0. Cancel anytime during the pilot: the service stops at the end of the month already paid, and you are not billed again. This page does not bill a fourth month and does not set a separate renewal price.
